rules.statement: The defendant cannot hold possession of the property as against a person who had a deed under the Fiscal, without proof that he is the recognized agent of his son.
rules.supporting_quote: [Lawrie, J.- Defendant has no authority to be in possession. I am not prepared to say that the transaction between the father and son is fraudulent; but without proof that he is the recognized agent of his son, he cannot hold possession as against a person who had a deed under the Fiscal.]
